extension.description: Conservative operation knowledge compiled from a contributor inventory.
extension.name: appimg

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: Unclassified invocation
safer_guidance: Inspect the exact target and required permissions before running this operation.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: Root invocation
safer_guidance: Use appimg list --json or appimg update --all --check instead of the interactive interface.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: adopt
safer_guidance: Run appimg adopt --scan first to see candidates, and inspect the file offline with unsquashfs -l before adopting it. adopt --dry-run is safe only from appimg 0.4.1 on.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: completions
safer_guidance: Inspect the exact target and required permissions before running this operation.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: doctor
safer_guidance: Inspect the exact target and required permissions before running this operation.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: edit
safer_guidance: Inspect the desktop entry in $XDG_DATA_HOME/applications before editing it.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: export
safer_guidance: Run appimg export without a file to print the export to standard output instead of writing a file.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: import
safer_guidance: Read the export file and confirm every listed source first. From appimg 0.4.1 on, import --dry-run shows what would be installed and from where.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: install
safer_guidance: Inspect the AppImage offline first, for example list its squashfs contents with unsquashfs -l (add -o with the offset past the ELF runtime). appimg install --dry-run is safe only from appimg 0.4.1 on; earlier versions run the AppImage.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: list
safer_guidance: Inspect the exact target and required permissions before running this operation.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: notify disable
safer_guidance: Run appimg notify status first to see which timer would be stopped and removed.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: notify enable
safer_guidance: Run appimg notify status first; enabling writes and starts a persistent systemd user timer.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: notify status
safer_guidance: Inspect the exact target and required permissions before running this operation.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: notify test
safer_guidance: Run appimg notify status to check the notification setup without showing a notification.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: remove
safer_guidance: Run appimg list first to confirm the exact application name.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: update
safer_guidance: Run appimg update --all --check, or appimg update NAME --check, first to see what would change.

permissions.description: Reviews inventoried operations; unknown invocations also require review.
permissions.label: update-source
safer_guidance: Run appimg update-source NAME without a source first, and confirm a new URL or github:owner/repo belongs to the application's publisher.
